title: Scenarios, rebalanced for Hard
body:
Scenarios are now won by beating every nation on the other side. Nukes are gone from wars before 1945. Korea starts closer: North Korea must hold the whole South for two and a half minutes, the UN fights from behind its Domes in Japan, and China joins if the UN nears the Yalu. In 1939 Germany strikes Poland first and the Soviets keep their pact until minute 20; in 1776 Britain's army lands in waves and France joins the Patriots.

You can also court the neutrals now: send gifts to win their goodwill, invite them to join your side, or, playing a neutral, ask to join one. Each leans the way history did, so some cost far more than others.

title: First life: a Conquest tutorial
body: New to Derpy Conquest? Live your first life as Thomas or Hannah Hale, a young cooper in Boston, 1700. About fifteen minutes, and 250 Derp Coins when you finish.

title: Watch replays together
body: Open any saved DerpyFront game with friends. The host plays, pauses and rewinds for everyone. Every replay now has a timeline you can drag, plus Back 10 seconds, Back 1 minute and Back to the start.

title: Random history and scenario goals
body: Random history drops you into a random war as a random nation. Every scenario nation has an optional historical goal: meet it on Hard or Impossible for 200 Derp Coins, once each.

title: Badges and profile pictures
body: Earn badges across Derp Land and pin up to three beside your name. Pick one of 35 pictures or upload your own.

title: Chapter one, revised
body: Foreign words now read by how much French he knows. He travels as John Locke, a wine shipper from San Diego.

title: Scenarios: nine historical wars
body:
Campaigns are now Scenarios: historical wars on maps you know, with real borders, capitals, forts and fleets from the first second.

- Europe 1939, World War I 1914 and Napoleon 1812
- The American Revolution 1776, as thirteen colonies or one Continental Army, on the new American Revolution - Detailed map
- The American Civil War 1861, the Korean War 1950, the Three Kingdoms 219 and Italy 1859

Pick a nation and play solo, or host a lobby and take nations with friends, on the same side or against each other. Sides are locked and win together, and a neutral you invade joins your enemies for good. Nations fight harder on their own soil, and armies weaken far from home.

title: The opening, and sound
body:
The night begins differently: the smoker under the awning, a proper hotel lobby with roped stairs and a dead lift, more regulars in the bar, and a new end to part one upstairs in room 23.

Mr. Based has sound now: rain, footsteps, doors and a quiet score, with volume sliders in settings.

title: Open lobbies, with passwords
body: Anyone can join any lobby from People in the top bar. Hosts can add a password, in the lobby settings in DerpyFront or the room setup in Conquest. People you invite or bring in your party get in without typing it.

title: Your dynasty
body: Journal › Dynasty shows your line's family tree: everyone you played, their families, and each one's life. Finished games keep their dynasty on your profile.

title: Weekly challenges
body: Three DerpyFront and three Derpy Conquest challenges every week, Monday to Monday: 100 to 250 Derp Coins each, plus 150 for finishing all three. This week's are on the home page.

title: Friends, who's online, and parties
body: People in the top bar shows who's on Derp Land and what they're playing. Add friends, invite them into your lobby or Conquest table, or make a party of up to 8 that follows the leader into games. Appear offline is in the account menu.

title: AI personalities
body: Mad Scientist, Trader, Aggressive and Protector, 750 Derp Coins each. Tick the ones you own when setting up a game: they're dealt to computer nations at random and shown in game. The Mad Scientist now saves up for Domes of Alden.

title: The latest OpenFront update
body: Computer nations play much better: more cities, ports and factories, and smarter nukes and defences. Two new maps, Ommatrypta and Brain Rot. Target is now J, and the emoji menu is on F. Trains are fixed at new stations, and the gold-per-10-seconds counter is gone.

title: Plunder, winter, and the Revolution to 1800
body: Legends: sacred places can now be plundered, with consequences, or protected as before. Winter comes to everyone's map from late November to early February, only where it really snows; Hard Winter is retired and its buyers refunded. The 1776 add-on now runs to 1800, with history following its course unless players change it.

title: An open world
body: Paris to explore at your own pace: double-click to run, rain that soaks you, an inventory, save slots, and the new skills and languages. You and the barman are your own models now, with new props in the bar and on the street.

title: 15 new skins, bigger payouts
body: Fifteen new skins in the Derp Store, five of them animated. DerpyFront games now pay about a sixth more Derp Coins.

title: 200 coins an hour, 64 new achievements
body: Conquest pays 200 Derp Coins an hour on top of what you earn in the game. 64 new achievements count for this game and overall; overall ones only count on Hard. The Conquest store has tabs now: Start Dates, Map Styles, Add-Ons.
